repertoireGraph.representation: BGE-M3 lyric-chunk centroids under primary duplicate control and shared-text-exclusion sensitivity
repertoireGraph.edgeRule: Both source-label profiles rank each other among their five closest matches in both duplicate-controlled text representations.
repertoireGraph.layoutMeaning: The global position is an approximate two-dimensional PCA summary of BGE-M3 repertoire profiles; only a released line represents the stricter reciprocal match rule.
repertoireGraph.claimBoundary: Lyrical-repertoire proximity between source-credit-labelled corpus slices; not verified identity, biography, popularity, affiliation, genre, collaboration, influence, social relationship, audio performance, or flow.

retrieval.claimBoundary: Held-out-song retrieval of corpus source-credit-label lyrical repertoire similarity; not artist identification, biography, influence, collaboration, genre, social relation, or a human semantic-similarity gold standard.
